Full code review of InkOS Messages v1 rebuild. Working dir: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

Block deploy if any CRITICAL finding. Report SEVERE / MINOR findings with file:line refs.

## Scope — what to review
Freshly shipped in this sprint across 4 agents (Dato, Koda backend, Koda frontend, Koda settings):

### Migrations
- `supabase/migrations/20260423100000_messages_v1_triage_templates.sql` — conversations ALTER, client_communications ALTER, message_templates + auto_reply_rules tables, RPCs triage_conversation + enqueue_auto_reply
- `supabase/migrations/20260423110000_studio_messaging_settings.sql` — studios ALTER for signature/hours/tone/connected_channels

### Backend
- `lib/messaging/queries.ts` (extended)
- `lib/messaging/mutations.ts` (extended)
- `lib/messaging/send.ts` (extended)
- `lib/messaging/triage.ts` (new)
- `lib/messaging/presence.ts` (new)
- `lib/messaging/templates-seed.ts` (new)
- `lib/billing/feature-gate.ts` (2 new keys)
- `lib/queue.ts` (new job type)
- `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx` (rewrite)
- `app/(app)/messages/actions.ts` (extended — 18+ actions)
- `app/api/webhooks/twilio/route.ts` (post-ingest triage + auto-reply)
- `app/api/webhooks/instagram/route.ts` (new)
- `app/api/webhooks/whatsapp/route.ts` (new)
- `app/api/webhooks/webchat/route.ts` (new)
- `workers/jobs/send-scheduled-message.ts` (new)

### Frontend (20 components + 4 hooks)
- `components/messages/*` — all files
- `hooks/messages/*` — all files

### Settings
- `app/(app)/settings/messaging/page.tsx` + `MessagingSettingsClient.tsx`
- `components/settings/messaging/*` — 4 files
- `lib/settings/navigation.ts` (modified)

## Review checklist (block on missing)

### Security (CRITICAL)
- [ ] RLS enabled on `message_templates` + `auto_reply_rules` with correct role-based policies
- [ ] No service-role client bypass in app code (webhook handlers OK to use it, no one else)
- [ ] Every webhook route verifies HMAC with `timingSafeEqual` (not `===`)
- [ ] Every webhook route has `apiRatelimit` from `lib/rate-limit.ts`
- [ ] Every server action calls `getAuthenticatedUser()` first
- [ ] Every server action input validated with Zod
- [ ] Dual-layer feature gate on `omnichannel_inbox` (server `requireFeatureRpc` + UI `<FeatureGate>`)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets
- [ ] No SQL injection in RPC functions (use parameter binding)
- [ ] `SECURITY DEFINER` functions have `SET search_path = public`

### TypeScript strictness (CRITICAL)
- [ ] Zero `any` across new code — grep `components/messages components/settings/messaging hooks/messages lib/messaging app/(app)/messages app/(app)/settings/messaging app/api/webhooks/instagram app/api/webhooks/whatsapp app/api/webhooks/webchat workers/jobs/send-scheduled-message.ts` for `: any`, `as any`, `// @ts-ignore`, `// @ts-expect-error`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes clean
- [ ] Generated types file was NOT hand-edited improperly (Dato did surgical edit — flag if structure looks wrong)

### Brand compliance (CRITICAL — InkOS CLAUDE.md section 4)
- [ ] Zero raw hex literals `#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}` in components/settings/hooks
- [ ] Zero default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-xl`, `shadow-2xl`)
- [ ] Zero banned color classes (`indigo-*`, `amber-*`, `emerald-*`, `green-*`, `pink-*`, `yellow-*`, `purple-*`, `violet-*`, `teal-*`, `cyan-*`)
- [ ] Instrument Serif only used on page titles / empty-state names / italic emphasis — never body/labels/numbers
- [ ] Rust used ≤2x per viewport (spot-check component count)
- [ ] `tailwind.config.ts` was NOT created
- [ ] Hardcoded `plan === 'pro'` checks don't exist — use `hasFeature()` or `<FeatureGate>`

### Error handling + logging (SEVERE)
- [ ] No `console.log` / `console.error` in production code paths — use `lib/logger.ts`
- [ ] Every server action wraps in try/catch returning `ActionResult`
- [ ] Webhook routes always return 200 on soft errors (don't break idempotency)
- [ ] Errors include `studio_id` / `conversation_id` context where relevant

### Next 16 gotchas (SEVERE)
- [ ] `cookies()` awaited (`await cookies()`)
- [ ] `searchParams` is `Promise<...>` type and awaited in Server Components
- [ ] `proxy.ts` at root (not `middleware.ts` — check it hasn't regressed)
- [ ] No `next/*` imports in workers/

### Data model (SEVERE)
- [ ] All new tables have `updated_at` trigger
- [ ] All foreign keys have supporting indexes
- [ ] Every RLS policy has explicit role check
- [ ] Partial indexes used where predicates narrow
- [ ] `CHECK` constraints on enum-ish text columns

### Accessibility (SEVERE)
- [ ] Every icon-only button has `aria-label`
- [ ] Focus rings visible on keyboard nav
- [ ] Landmarks on panes: `<nav>`, `<section>`, `<aside>`
- [ ] Color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (Stone `#787774` on Bone `#F7F7F5` = 4.67:1 — OK)

### SaaS IA separation (MINOR — per saas-ia-separation.md)
- [ ] `/settings/messaging` lives in settings, not sidebar top
- [ ] Main sidebar has only "Messages" (no duplicates)

### Performance (MINOR)
- [ ] No N+1 queries in context pane fetch (parallel Promise.all)
- [ ] Realtime subscriptions cleaned up on unmount
- [ ] No unnecessary re-renders (key on list, memo where needed)
- [ ] Images lazy-loaded (reference-image gallery)

## Deliverables
1. CRITICAL / SEVERE / MINOR findings table with file:line references
2. Pass/fail on each checklist section
3. Go/no-go verdict for deploy


Report under 1500 tokens. No filler. No motivational copy. Just findings + verdict.

-- Purpose  : Messages v1 rebuild — triage tags, auto-reply engine,

-- Tables   : message_templates (new), auto_reply_rules (new)

-- Functions: triage_conversation, enqueue_auto_reply
-- Rollback :
--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS enqueue_auto_reply(uuid, uuid);

--   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS auto_reply_rules;
--   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS message_templates;

--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS scheduled_for,

--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS resolved_at,
--     DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS triage_tag;
--   DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_conversations_studio_triage;
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- 1. ALTER conversations
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE conversations
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS triage_tag text
    CHECK (triage_tag IN (
      'inquiry', 'booking', 'client', 'rescheduling',
      'pricing', 'deposit_paid', 'missed_call'
    ));

ALTER TABLE conversations
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resolved_at timestamptz;

ALTER TABLE conversations
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_auto_reply_at timestamptz;

-- Index: filter by triage in non-archived threads (used by ConversationList tabs)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_studio_triage
  ON conversations (studio_id, triage_tag)
  WHERE archived_at IS NULL AND triage_tag IS NOT NULL;

-- ============================================================
-- 2. ALTER client_communications
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE client_communications
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_internal_note boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

ALTER TABLE client_communications
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scheduled_for timestamptz;

-- Soft reference — no FK on purpose; safe for message threading future-use
ALTER TABLE client_communications
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reply_to_message_id uuid;

-- Partial index: worker polls for queued messages that are due to send
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comms_scheduled
  ON client_communications (scheduled_for)
  WHERE scheduled_for IS NOT NULL AND status = 'queued';

-- ============================================================
-- 3. CREATE TABLE message_templates
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS message_templates (
  id                uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id         uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name              text        NOT NULL,
  slug              text        NOT NULL,                               -- URL-safe identifier
  body              text        NOT NULL,
  channel           text        NOT NULL
    CHECK (channel IN ('sms', 'email', 'both')),
  category          text        NOT NULL
    CHECK (category IN (
      'aftercare', 'deposit', 'booking', 'portfolio',
      'reschedule', 'inquiry_reply', 'custom'
    )),
  trigger_keywords  text[]      NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_default        boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_by        uuid        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,  -- PII:L2
  created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT uq_message_templates_studio_slug UNIQUE (studio_id, slug)
);

COMMENT ON COLUMN message_templates.created_by IS 'PII:L2 — user reference, internal';

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_message_templates_studio_category
  ON message_templates (studio_id, category);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_message_templates_studio_default
  ON message_templates (studio_id)
  WHERE is_default = true;

-- updated_at trigger (function set_updated_at already exists from Sprint 13 migration)
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_message_templates_updated_at ON message_templates;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_message_templates_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON message_templates
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

-- ── RLS on message_templates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE message_templates ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- SELECT: any active studio member can read templates for their studio
CREATE POLICY "message_templates_select"
  ON message_templates
  FOR SELECT
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = message_templates.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
    )
  );

-- INSERT: active member (owner/admin/artist/receptionist); created_by must be caller
CREATE POLICY "message_templates_insert"
  ON message_templates
  FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (
    created_by = auth.uid()
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = message_templates.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'artist', 'receptionist')
    )
  );

-- UPDATE: owner/admin can update any row; artist/receptionist only own rows
CREATE POLICY "message_templates_update"
  ON message_templates
  FOR UPDATE
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = message_templates.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND (
          sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
          OR (sm.role IN ('artist', 'receptionist') AND message_templates.created_by = auth.uid())
        )
    )
  );

-- DELETE: owner/admin only (templates may be referenced by auto-reply rules)
CREATE POLICY "message_templates_delete"
  ON message_templates
  FOR DELETE
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = message_templates.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
    )
  );

-- ============================================================
-- 4. CREATE TABLE auto_reply_rules
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auto_reply_rules (
  id                uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id         uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  trigger_type      text        NOT NULL
    CHECK (trigger_type IN ('new_inquiry', 'missed_call', 'deposit_paid', 'keyword')),
  keyword           text,                                               -- required when trigger_type='keyword'
  template_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES message_templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  enabled           boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  cooldown_minutes  int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 60,
  tone              text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'casual'
    CHECK (tone IN ('casual', 'formal')),
  created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  -- keyword is required if and only if trigger_type = 'keyword'
  CONSTRAINT chk_auto_reply_rules_keyword
    CHECK ((trigger_type = 'keyword') = (keyword IS NOT NULL)),

  -- One rule per (studio, trigger_type, keyword); NULLS NOT DISTINCT handles the
  -- singleton non-keyword rules where keyword IS NULL (Postgres 15+)
  CONSTRAINT uq_auto_reply_rules_studio_trigger_keyword
    UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)
);

-- Index: fast lookup from webhook handler (filter enabled rules for a studio + trigger)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auto_reply_rules_studio_enabled_trigger
  ON auto_reply_rules (studio_id, enabled, trigger_type);

-- updated_at trigger
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_auto_reply_rules_updated_at ON auto_reply_rules;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_auto_reply_rules_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON auto_reply_rules
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

-- ── RLS on auto_reply_rules ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE auto_reply_rules ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- SELECT: any active studio member can read rules (needed by webhook + settings UI)
CREATE POLICY "auto_reply_rules_select"
  ON auto_reply_rules
  FOR SELECT
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = auto_reply_rules.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
    )
  );

-- INSERT: owner/admin only — rules affect all outbound comms
CREATE POLICY "auto_reply_rules_insert"
  ON auto_reply_rules
  FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = auto_reply_rules.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
    )
  );

-- UPDATE: owner/admin only
CREATE POLICY "auto_reply_rules_update"
  ON auto_reply_rules
  FOR UPDATE
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = auto_reply_rules.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
    )
  );

-- DELETE: owner/admin only
CREATE POLICY "auto_reply_rules_delete"
  ON auto_reply_rules
  FOR DELETE
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = auto_reply_rules.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
    )
  );

-- ============================================================
-- 5. FUNCTION triage_conversation
--    Applies deterministic rule-based triage to a conversation,
--    writes the result back to conversations.triage_tag, and
--    returns the applied tag as text.
--    Called from: Twilio/inbound webhook after comm INSERT.
--    SECURITY DEFINER: webhook service-role bypass not needed;
--    function runs with owner privileges so RLS checks pass.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION triage_conversation(
  p_conversation_id uuid
)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_studio_id   uuid;
  v_client_id   uuid;
